atAGlance: Cà phê cốt dừa turns strong Vietnamese coffee into a coconut-cream café treat, cold, rich, and especially welcome in beach-city heat.
whatItIs: Cà phê cốt dừa layers bitter robusta coffee with icy coconut cream or coconut slush. It tastes like coffee and dessert meeting in the same glass.
howToEnjoy: Stir just enough to pull coffee through the coconut, then taste before adding sugar. The best version keeps the coffee bitter enough to balance the sweet coconut.
howLocalsOrder: Order cà phê cốt dừa when you want a cold, dessert-like coffee. Ask for less sweetness, extra coffee, or less ice if you want it less sweet, stronger, or richer.
worthKnowing: Vietnamese cafés use robusta bitterness well here: the coffee keeps the coconut from tasting flat or candy-sweet.
goodToKnow: Usually sweet and creamy; ask before ordering if you avoid dairy or coconut cream.
